videos.video_subject: Dolores Aveiro has spoken publicly about how, with three children already and no money, she asked a doctor about ending her pregnancy with Cristiano and the doctor refused
videos.video_script: She already had three children and no money at all. She asked a doctor to end the pregnancy. He refused. That refusal gave football its most famous number seven.
